headline: Pinnacle West Capital (PNW) Stock Looks Overvalued On Dividends But Fair On Earnings
summary: Pinnacle West Capital stock has delivered a 55.0% return over the past five years, yet the latest valuation checks suggest the shares are closer to fairly priced, with the Dividend Discount Model (DDM) pointing to a premium to its intrinsic value while market multiples look more in line. A 55.0% total return over five years highlights that long term holders in Pinnacle West Capital have already captured a meaningful gain.
